- **E0705** (poem, sure): 嘉庆 《含辉楼远望》 自注 (as quoted in S220). 嘉庆十七年 1812 (S220) · S220 section 四; primary not seen · S220. http://iqh.ruc.edu.cn/old/qdhjylyjzx/xszl/ylfj/00baad8cc3da4c6a901378da7919d9a8.htm
  > 绮春园内之西南偏，旧以缭墙别界一区，名曰含晖园。又横界一区，名曰西爽村。中有联辉楼，为成亲王寓园憩止之所。
  In the south-west of the garden a walled area was once 含晖园 and another, set across it, 西爽村, with 联辉楼 Lianhui Lou where Prince Cheng rested.
- **E0442** (text, sure): 清稗類鈔 宮苑類 綺春園. 1917 · line 2100 of the corpus file · S214. https://github.com/garychowcmu/daizhigev20/blob/master/子藏/类书/清稗类钞.txt
  > 绮春园含晖园在圆明园东，有复道相属，仁宗三女庄敬公主厘降时，赐居于此。公主薨，额驸索特那木多尔济照例缴进，又以成哲亲王寓园西爽村均并入绮春园中。道光时，宣宗尊养孝和后于绮春园，文宗初元，亦奉孝静后居此，问安视膳，一如道光间礼.盖文宗幼时失母，为孝静所抚育，故即位后孝静由康慈皇贵太妃尊为太后也。咸丰庚申淀园之灾，绮春亦同归煨烬矣。
  How 綺春園 grew: 含暉園 joined by a covered way for the princess, handed back at her death, with 西爽村 added. Consorts lived there under Daoguang and Xianfeng, and it burned with the rest in 1860.
- **E0448** (text, sure): 《養吉齋叢錄》 on 綺春園 and the Thirty Scenes. Qing; text states events up to 文宗 · 卷十八 leaf 4 (archive.org 02096508.cn image n52-n53) · S223. https://archive.org/details/02096508.cn/page/n52
  > 綺春園在圓明園東，有複道相屬。舊為大學士傅恆及其子大學士福康安賜園，歿後繳進，嘉慶間始加繕葺。仁宗御製綺春園三十景詩，有宣宗恭跋：先是，園西南以繚垣別界一區，名含暉園，莊敬和碩公主釐降時，賜居於此。公主薨逝，額駙索特那木多布齋以園繳進。舊又橫界一區，名西爽村，有聯暉樓，為成邸寓園。嘉慶間成邸別賜園宅，西爽、含暉皆併入為一園，而規模宏遠矣。舊有數楹名鳳麐洲，後易名清夏齋；問月樓在洲之南，鏡綠亭在洲之北。道光時為尊養孝和皇太后之所，正殿曰迎暉殿。文宗登極，奉康慈太后亦居此，問安視膳，皆如道光間禮。三十景者：敷春堂　鑑德書屋　翠合軒　凌虛閣　協性齋　澄光榭　問月樓　我見室　蔚藻堂　藹芳圃　鏡綠亭　淙玉軒　舒卉軒　竹林院　夕霏榭　清夏齋　鏡虹館　春雨山房　含光樓（即舊時聯暉樓）　涵清館　華滋庭　苔香室　虛明鏡　含淳堂　春澤齋　水心榭　四宜書屋　茗柯精舍　來薰室　般若觀
  The earliest list of the Thirty Scenes we can see, and the history before it seems to come from Daoguang's colophon to Jiaqing's poem set (有宣宗恭跋). It places 問月樓 south of 洲 and 鏡綠亭 north of it, names 迎暉殿 as the main hall of the dowager's residence, and equates 含光樓 with the old 聯暉樓. Punctuation is ours; the print has none. Transcribed by eye.
- **E0717** (poem, sure): 嘉庆 《含光楼》 (as quoted in S224). 嘉庆, undated in S224 · S224 section on 嘉庆; primary not seen · S224. https://www.yuanmingyuanpark.cn/ymyyj/yj032/201504/t20150420_693218.html
  > 联辉昔日雁行聚，鸿影翩翻云路高。柳下分堋同较射，花间觅句共挥毫。清谈犹忆凭朱槛，嘉数还看荫碧皋。偶憩堂阴怀旧雨，绿杨溪畔放轻舠。
  The only poem of the Thirty Scenes we could read whole. Jiaqing recalls archery and verse with his brother Prince Cheng at the old 聯輝 tower: vermilion railings, willows, targets set up, a stream with a light boat.
- **E0718** (poem, sure): 道光 《季春含辉楼马射》 (as quoted in S220). 道光 (S220) · S220 section 五; primary not seen · S220. http://iqh.ruc.edu.cn/old/qdhjylyjzx/xszl/ylfj/00baad8cc3da4c6a901378da7919d9a8.htm
  > 绮春胜境御园南，电掣青骢驰骤谙。金埒鸣鞭矢中六，琼楼载咏月逢三。柳垂碧线晴烟掩，草展文茵晓露含。缅忆当年承渥泽，时光迁易意何堪。
  Mounted archery in the third month before 含辉楼: it confirms a riding track and lawn in front of the tower, willow-lined. S220 says archery moved here from 出入贤良门 under Daoguang (e.g. four times in the fourth month of 1830). QC13-N01 is the plan's 撒马道 riding track.
- **E0719** (poem, sure): 道光 《恭侍皇太后含辉楼观灯喜成》 (as quoted in S220). 道光三年 or 五年 (S220 implies; poem undated there) · S220 section 五; primary not seen · S220. http://iqh.ruc.edu.cn/old/qdhjylyjzx/xszl/ylfj/00baad8cc3da4c6a901378da7919d9a8.htm
  > 昔年马射沐恩隆，今岁今宵事岂同。疏柳清池仍此地，华灯鼓乐触予衷。承欢伊始层楼畅，因便何妨御苑东。灿烂鱼龙争曼衍，欣看月上不生风。
  Lantern-viewing with the dowager from 含辉楼. The poem gives a storeyed building beside sparse willows and a clear pool, with room for archery earlier in the year.
- **E1186** (text, sure): 養吉齋叢錄 卷十三. mid-19th c. (printed 1890s), on earlier reigns · 卷十三, line 929 of the corpus file · S202. https://raw.githubusercontent.com/garychowcmu/daizhigev20/master/%E5%8F%B2%E8%97%8F/%E5%BF%97%E5%AD%98%E8%AE%B0%E5%BD%95/%E5%85%BB%E5%90%89%E6%96%8B%E4%B8%9B%E5%BD%95.txt
  > 乾隆间，每岁上元前，于清晖阁张灯，侍皇太后筵宴。道光间，于含辉楼张灯，侍皇太后筵宴。御园中放灯收灯，以鸣锣传令。早晚有定时，一处鸣锣，五处应之。司房帖传掌仪司，不知自何时始也。
  Lamps before the Lantern Festival were hung at 清暉閣 under Qianlong and at 含暉樓 under Daoguang, for banquets with the empress dowager. Gongs at set times signalled lighting and putting out lamps.

  Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 含辉楼, 1812, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.
- **E0703** (poem, sure): 含辉楼: 嘉庆十七年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor. 嘉庆十七年 (1812), date from the compilation · p.298 item (2), under 含辉楼 · S360. https://www.yuanmingyuanpark.cn/xs/yjbg/202007/P020200730387572832602.pdf#page=298
  > 别墅初开生面新，绮春旧境迹仍陈。迁乔欣接飞鸿影（绮春园内之西南偏，旧以缭墙别界一区，名曰含晖园，又横界一区，名曰西爽村，中有联辉楼为成亲王寓园憩止之所，予经帷之暇，亦常拈吟较射于其中，后成亲王经予别赐园宅，迁移巳逾十稔矣。），厘降怆飘野马尘（嗣以庄敬和硕公主下降，亦曾赐居含晖园，去岁公主病逝，复经额驸索特那木多布斋呈缴。）。
  Jiaqing, 1812, the fullest history of this corner: his note says 含晖园 and 西爽村 were walled off inside 绮春园, with 联辉楼 lent to Prince Cheng, then to Princess Zhuangjing, returned after her death.
- **E0706** (poem, sure): 含辉楼: 嘉庆十九年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor. 嘉庆十九年 (1814), date from the compilation · p.298 item (3), under 含辉楼 · S360. https://www.yuanmingyuanpark.cn/xs/yjbg/202007/P020200730387572832602.pdf#page=298
  > 步陟层楼上，芳园眼界开。旭辉平渚灿，云净远峰嵬。德洽能移俗，心清可息埃。甫田又望泽，孟夏愿宏恢。

  > 可爱冬窗日，暖辉楼徧含。菊盆香益淡，枫砌色仍酣。烟敛山飞翠，光澄霄滴蓝。吟成消片刻，敬事问都篮。

- **E0709** (poem, sure): 含辉楼: 嘉庆二十二年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor. 嘉庆二十二年 (1817), date from the compilation · p.298 item (5), under 含辉楼 · S360. https://www.yuanmingyuanpark.cn/xs/yjbg/202007/P020200730387572832602.pdf#page=298
  > 绮春园境广，修治通墙垣。营建发内帑，淳朴如乡村。屋舍皆雅洁，全无雕绘痕。楼临绿荷沼，时有香风翻。含熏几席爽，午辉窗牖暄。工作不宜数，峻宇古训存。罢役息民力，服畴固本原，先圣卑宫室。尚俭习俗敦。
  Jiaqing, 1817: the garden's walls joined up, paid from the privy purse, plain like a village and without painted work; the tower over a lotus pond.
- **E0710** (poem, sure): 含辉楼: 嘉庆二十四年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor. 嘉庆二十四年 (1819), date from the compilation · p.298 item (6), under 含辉楼 · S360. https://www.yuanmingyuanpark.cn/xs/yjbg/202007/P020200730387572832602.pdf#page=298
  > 绮春园接含辉楼，苑墙连属门径由。试启纱疏舒远止，云外西山一碧浮。栏前荷渚平桥畔，又见田田满陂岸。水芳涵泽根蒂深，转瞬千枝霞锦灿。肩舆徐度绿杨蹊，密荫相联内外堤。宛似余杭标胜㮣，昔年游迹印尘泥。
  Jiaqing, 1819: the tower joined by a wall and gate to the garden, view of the Western Hills, lotus by a flat bridge, willow causeways compared with Hangzhou.
- **E0711** (poem, sure): 含辉楼: 道光三年 poem of the Daoguang Emperor. 道光三年 (1823), date from the compilation · p.298 item (7), under 含辉楼 · S360. https://www.yuanmingyuanpark.cn/xs/yjbg/202007/P020200730387572832602.pdf#page=298
  > 昔年马射沐恩隆，今岁今宵事岂同。疎柳清池仍此地，华镫鼓乐触予衷。承欢伊始层楼畅，因便何妨御苑东。灿烂鱼龙争曼衍，欣看月上不生风（含辉楼者，昔年马射之 地也。元夕后一日，张镫陈戏，恭侍安舆，是日午前，多风，入座之后，遂尔恬息，慈颜怡悦，朕亦蔚欣）。
  Daoguang, 1823: lanterns and plays for the dowager; his note calls the tower the old riding-archery ground.

  > 禁园恰值小阳时，挟矢调弓骑射宜。木落高峰晴旭丽，草枯长埒薄霜披。矢能连中由慈训，身莫忘劳守旧规。电掣青骢欣惬意，几余肄武一驱驰。

  > ◎御园侍游玉将军（明）有《侍游御园记》，成竹坪同年（林）曾属予代作跋语，恭书于后。按，《记》云：“咸丰六年秋七月二十一日，奉旨：本日散朝后，著玉明、肃顺自备鞍马，午初一刻进西南门，在山高水长伺候。有顷，上从内乘船，至山高水长后阁扇下船，出前门，谕玉明、肃顺暨珠勒亨、西拉布、托云、德勒格尔、伊勒东阿等脱去外褂。上乘马，命七臣随行。自山高水长游藻园，至厂地，过汇芳书院，复由紫碧山房至鱼跃鸢飞少坐。过蕊珠宫门，至黄花磴进茶毕，往西洋楼海宴堂，至转马台，过小角门，至狮子林清淑斋赏饭。左右四卓，命七臣坐，并奉温谕可饱食，非外边筵宴比也。上命膳房先给七臣面各一器，上进面，复进饭，颁赏御用菜蔬，七臣叩头谢。上进粥，复赏粥毕。随驾起行，由宝相寺、法慧寺、谐奇趣过明春门，至雷峰夕照马头，坐如在天上船，游福海。上命笔砚作诗毕，至渊氵亭镜澈马头下船。进丽春门骑马，由旧园东墙根过敷春堂，游西大堤汉城关，至含辉楼下马，命七臣散归。玉明自道光十一年由侍卫擢厕御前二十余年，仰邀优渥，得遍瞻御园盛景。欣感之余，谨作记以纪荣遇。”
  A rare first-hand record of a day in the garden four years before its destruction. The emperor takes seven officials by a named route from 山高水長 through 藻園, 彚芳書院, 紫碧山房 and 魚躍鳶飛, past 蕊珠宫門, on to 海宴堂 in the 西洋樓, a meal at 清淑齋 in 獅子林, 寳相寺, 法慧寺, 諧奇趣, by boat on 福海, then 敷春堂 and 含暉楼. All were standing then.

  Same table. In it the first group shows no visible remains; 得全阁, 流香渚, 凤麟洲, 涵秋馆, 蔚藻堂, 中和堂, 敷春堂 and 心镜轩 have service buildings on them, and 含晖楼, 澄心堂, 延寿寺, 清夏堂 and 喜雨山房 are occupied by other institutions. 澹泊宁静 and several others have been dug since, so this is out of date for them.
- **E0720** (description, sure): 圆明园百景史事分景汇编: 含辉楼. 1812-1859 · from p.298, under 含辉楼 · S360. https://www.yuanmingyuanpark.cn/xs/yjbg/202007/P020200730387572832602.pdf#page=298
  A Jiaqing note of 1812 says this south-west corner was once walled off as 含晖园 and 西爽村, with the 联辉楼 lent to Prince Cheng and later to Princess Zhuangjing. A Daoguang note of 1823 calls the tower the old riding-archery ground, and the court watched archery here almost every spring until 1859. 含辉楼: 42 dated items, 1812-1859, of which 10 poems and 32 court records (Jiaqing, Daoguang, Xianfeng); recurring themes: archery, visits to the dowager, the view. First dated 1812, last dated 1859.
- **E0722** (description, sure): 圆明园五朝御制诗文集注 v4, editors' note on 含辉楼. 2020 edition · v4 p.317 · S361. https://www.yuanmingyuanpark.cn/xs/yjbg/202008/P020200803382796786124.pdf#page=320
  Given to Prince Yongxuan about 1773 as 含晖园, to Princess Zhuangjing in 1801, returned in 1811 as 南园, when 联辉楼 was moved here from 西爽村. Main tower two storeys of seven bays, with a riding track 撤马道 south of it and 招凉榭, a five-bay open hall, on an islet. Its gates are 环翠 and the city-style south gate with Jiaqing's plaques 护松扉 and 排青幌. North of it lie 清夏斋 and 延英论道.
- **E0721** (description, likely): 圆明园五朝御制诗文集注 v4, editors' note on 云漪馆. 2020 edition · v4 p.351 · S361. https://www.yuanmingyuanpark.cn/xs/yjbg/202008/P020200803382796786124.pdf#page=354
  Late Jiaqing, north of the lake from 澄心堂 and east of 含辉楼: five bays in two rolls, with a wing, and a square pavilion to the south-west. It has no row in the building list.
